Emboar

Fire Fighting

Unova · Generation 5

Emboar is a Fire/Fighting-type Mega Fire Pig Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.6 m tall and weighs 150 kg. It evolves from Pignite. Its highest base stat is Attack (123), with a base stat total of 528.
